prompt:
A measurement tool throws when the question-set directory it was explicitly given does not exist, instead of substituting a bundled default. A reviewer calls this unfriendly and proposes falling back so a run never fails on a typo.

A run that scores the wrong question set still completes and produces an artifact that downstream tooling treats as a valid baseline.

Decide whether throwing is the right behavior.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
